headline: PILOT 🗡️ STABS 🩸 Co-Pilot ✈️ Mid-FLIGHT 🌪️ to ISRAEL 🇮🇱
text:
FLYDUBAI ✈️ flight 🛫 FZ1073 took OFF 🚀 from DUBAI 🕌 at 03:05 GMT ⏰ carrying AT 🧳 least 150 👥 souls mostly ISRAELI 🇮🇱 when ONE 🧑‍✈️ pilot suddenly STABBED 🗡️ the OTHER 🩸 captain HARD 💥 apparently trying TO 💥 CRASH 🌀 the whole PLANE 🛩️ into OBLIVION 🌍!! Israeli PRIME 🧔‍♂️ Minister Benjamin NETANYAHU 📢 confirmed the CHAOS 😱 after the aircraft went INTO 🌀 a wild SPIN 🌀 and began DESCENDING 📉 rapidly over SAUDI 🕋 territory dropping a jaw dropping 17,000 FEET 🦶 in under TWO ⏳ minutes flat!! Passengers SCREAMED 🗣️ thinking they were DONE ❌ for but an ISRAELI 👨‍🚀 passenger plus CREW 👨‍✈️ members busted INTO 🚪 the cockpit and OVERPOWERED 💪 the stabby PILOT 🗡️ tying him UP ⛓️ with his own ZIP 🧥 ties and some multimedia HEADPHONES 🎧 resourcefulness at its FINEST 🏆 bro they built DIFFERENT 🦸‍♂️!!

The WOUNDED 🩸 captain and first OFFICER 🧑‍✈️ were both INJURED 🤕 rushed to HOSPITAL 🏥 in Tabuk after the emergency LANDING 🛬 at 06:58 while the ATTACKER 🚨 got arrested immediately by SAUDI 👮‍♂️ authorities and is now under QUESTIONING 🔎 with Netanyahu calling it a serious SECURITY 🛡️ incident that almost became a major DISASTER 💥!! Israeli DEFENCE 🛡️ Minister Israel KATZ labeled the whole thing an attempted JIHADIST ☪️ terror attack though the BBC 📡 still awaits official MOTIVE 🕵️ statements from police or investigators on what triggered this unhinged COCKPIT 🪑 brawl!! One PASSENGER 👩 named Yasmin Abukasis told REUTERS 📢 her daughter described a MAN 🧔 holding a KNIFE 🔪 forcing a pilot to the FLOOR 🛡️ with blood EVERYWHERE 🩸 and people SCREAMING 🗣️ as the plane started LOSING 🌀 control completely!! Her daughter heard the PILOT 🧑‍✈️ calling for HELP 🆘 before two OTHER 🧑‍✈️ pilots and passengers charged the knife guy like absolute HEROS 🦸‍♂️ saving everyone from certain DOOM 🌋!!

Zvika MENESS 🧔 told Kan NEWS 📺 that his young DAUGHTER 👧 was in the TOILET 🚽 with his wife when they heard SHOUTING 📢 erupting from the COCKPIT 🚪 an extra CREW 👨‍✈️ member who was also a PILOT 🧑‍✈️ rushed in and that's when they WITNESSED 👀 the actual STABBING 🗡️ unfold right before their EYES 👁️!! Meness said he and TWO ✌️ other dudes JUMPED 🦘 on the attacker FORCEFULLY 🥋 neutralizing him with zip ties and HEADPHONES 🎧 pure resourcefulness under extreme PRESSURE ⏳ while another pilot from the CABIN 🛋️ stepped up to HELP 🛠️ land the plane safely at Tabuk AIRPORT 🛬!! Almog Itali who was also ABOARD 🧳 revealed one of the landing PILOTS 🧑‍✈️ was BRITISH 🇬🇧 and the other was EUROPEAN 🌍 though he kept the exact nationality under WRAPS 🤫!!

A female PASSENGER 👩 described the very STRESSFUL 😬 moment when everyone realized the PLANE 🛩️ was descending uncontrollably saying they understood the PILOTS 🧑‍✈️ had lost CONTROL 🎮 with shirts covered in BLOOD 🩸 everywhere yet now they are FINE 🙏 and just want to get HOME 🏠 to their families!! Meness added there are CHILDREN 👦 and families who endured a highly TRAUMATIC 😢 event that will haunt them but thankfully the HEROES 🦸‍♂️ prevented total catastrophe!! Shortly AFTER ⏰ the incident both ISRAELI 🇮🇱 and SAUDI 🕋 air forces scrambled FIGHTER JETS 🛩️ while Netanyahu held urgent CONSULTATIONS 🗣️ hailing the brave passengers and crew for their extraordinary COURAGE 💪 that saved so MANY 🛟 lives!!

FLYDUBAI ✈️ later confirmed an altercation broke OUT 🥊 in the flight DECK 🛠️ but the plane was successfully SECURED 🔒 by on duty CREW 👨‍✈️ who were traveling as PASSENGERS 🧳 diverting and landing safely at TABUK 🛬 airport with zero impact on other FLIGHTS 🛫!! They dispatched two REPLACEMENT ✈️ aircraft to bring everyone HOME 🏠 the repatriation flight left at 17:40 local and touched down in TEL AVIV 🕍 around 18:40 with the airline stressing their priority is the SAFETY 🛡️ health and wellbeing of all involved while fully supporting the official INVESTIGATION 🕵️!! Netanyahu added Israeli forces are in close CONTACT 📞 with relevant authorities to keep the passengers SAFE 🔐 saluting those heroes once again for stopping a potential major DISASTER 💥 that could have been so much WORSE 😱!!
